title: Choose Nova's visual world
question: Choose the system Nova should use to make active tryouts clear, calm, and shared.

options.label: Fieldhouse Wayfinding
options.lineage: tournament venue directories and regional field maps
options.thesis: One shared campaign map makes every role, player, and next action easy to locate.
options.viewport: The campaign phase line anchors the top while a scan-ready player field carries evaluation state and placement actions in place.
options.risk: It becomes decorative if route markers do not correspond to real campaign state.

options.label: Live Tile Panorama
options.thesis: Large role pivots and live player tiles turn the campaign into a wide, stateful panorama.
options.viewport: A giant campaign title leads into a horizontal roster, evaluation, and placement panorama with the next pane always peeking in.
options.risk: The spatial navigation may slow users who expect conventional tabs and lists.
options.case: Strong product clarity through live state; moderate audience identification because the panorama is unfamiliar to club staff.

options.label: Role Score
options.thesis: Administrator and evaluator actions flank a central campaign timeline as one coordinated score.
options.viewport: A central campaign staff divides administrator and evaluator lanes while player actions accumulate around the current phase.
options.risk: The notation metaphor may make familiar operations feel more abstract than necessary.
options.case: Moderate clarity for role lanes and timing; low audience identification because staff do not think in dance notation.

options.label: Campaign Depth
options.thesis: The campaign descends through enrollment, evaluation, and placement with observations pinned to exact phases.
options.viewport: A vertical campaign profile owns the screen, with roster evidence and unresolved decisions pinned to their phase.
options.risk: The literal descent conflicts with parallel tryout work and overstates the kelp identity.
options.case: Moderate progression clarity; low audience identification because the dive metaphor is distant from club operations.

canonCard.label: Polished operations dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar sidebar, page header, summary cards, tables, and forms executed at a high craft level.
canonCard.viewport: A standard navigation shell frames campaign metrics, recent activity, and clearly grouped primary actions.
canonCard.risk: Even with excellent craft, Nova may still look interchangeable with unrelated SaaS tools.
